audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Skill for levels 1 through 6; the content layer and the packet both read Azir at levels 1-2, Lissandra at 3, 4-5 and 6, then Azir on both item rows.
audit.why: Glacial Path does not exist until level 3, and it is 24 seconds at rank 1 — before that she cannot reach a champion who holds the 740 soldier line. From level 3 her claw-into-Ring-of-Frost rhythm starts landing, and Frozen Tomb at 550 range settles level 6. Nashor's flips it back.
audit.corrected: All five stale full-layer sides moved onto the content chart (Azir, Azir, Lissandra, Lissandra, Lissandra) with every moved row's why rewritten in the same proposal. win[0..6] already matched, so the two layers now agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer claimed three separate times that Lissandra 'has no ranged poke'.
audit.why: Ice Shard is 725 range on 7/6/5/4/3 seconds and the shards pass through the target. She absolutely has ranged poke — what she lacks is reach past 725 against a 740-range soldier line, which is a much more useful thing to tell the reader.
audit.corrected: whys[0], spikes[2].text and the early paragraph now give the two numbers that actually decide the spacing: Ice Shard 725, Ring of Frost 450, your soldier line 740.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no number at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and the page never described how her combo is actually assembled or what her ultimate does when self-cast.
audit.why: Glacial Path is 24/21/18/15/12s at 1050 range — she casts the claw, then reactivates to travel to it. Ring of Frost roots at only 450 range on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. Frozen Tomb is 120/100/80s: cast on you it stuns at 550, cast on herself it heals her and makes her untargetable and invulnerable, which is why Grievous Wounds decides extended fights (the interaction flagged in missingInteractions).
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns and ranges written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and the phase whys; the self-cast heal and the anti-heal timing folded into breakdown.feeding.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nineteen lint findings: MISGENDER across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, loading, two phase whys, wave, trading, two Do's titles and one Do's body, plus five report entries; two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets; the empty cooldowns field.
audit.why: Lissandra is female per champ-data/champ-gender.js. dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim under a spacing title; dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under a flank-warding title.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in every field edited; both bled bullets replaced with bodies that answer their titles.

notes: Full-layer chart was stale on five of seven rows and has been moved onto the content chart and the packet, which agreed with each other; every moved side has its why rewritten in the same proposal and win[] needed no edit. The biggest factual defect was the content layer asserting three times that Lissandra has no ranged poke — Ice Shard is 725 range on a cooldown that reaches 3 seconds. Lint flagged MISGENDER on report[3].t, report[4].t and report[9].t too; the two-rewrite cap on report[] left those untouched, so they still need a pronoun-only pass. Unverified: whether Frozen Tomb's stun can be cleansed or reduced by tenacity, and whether Emperor's Divide can displace her mid-Glacial-Path travel — neither kit file answers either, so no claim about them appears in the text.
